main_text.p: Obliqui sunt, qui ductu obliquo protensi retentrici virtuti ministrant.Obliqui.
main_text.head: CAPUT XL. DE VENTRICVLO.
main_text.p: Peculiaria[?] membra conservatricis vitalis sunt, quae soli conservatrici vitali facultati peculiarem sui usum & ministerium exhibent.
Suntq; organa vel concoctionis nutrimenti, vel expulsionis excrementi.
Membra concoctionis sunt, quae alterando, elaborando, & concoquendo alimento inserviunt.Membra concoctio-nus.
Concoctionis membrum est vel mediatae, vel immediatae concoctionis.
Utrumq; est principale, vel minus principale seu administrum.
Mediata concoctionis membrum est χυλώ-σεως, vel αἱματώσεως.Membrum χυλώσεως.
Membrum chylofeos est quasi culina pri-ma, in qua nutrimenta sumta prima alteratione in chylum elaborata, & versa excoquuntur.

page.notes: Catchword "cremor" at lower right, taken as the catchword. Faint ghost text (show-through from the reverse side, including a faint marginal word near the top right beside the heading, and faint lines at the bottom left) is not transcribed. The woodcut initial at the start of "Peculiaria" is decorative; the first letter is doubtful. Small caps in "CHYLUS" and italic in the Greek are as printed. Printed hyphens kept at line ends in "χυλώ-σεως", "pri-ma" and "ver-sa" (the last reads "ver-sa" in the scan; check against the line break "ver-"/"sa").
